description: Complete Token Event JSON from KoboldCPP Streaming API

notes: 28 layers × 28 heads × 256 context tokens = 200,704 float32 values

python: # Higher values = more attention to that position (probabilities sum to ~1.0 per head)

use_cases.brightness_scoring: Average across layers/heads to get per-token brightness score
use_cases.attention_visualization: Render heatmap showing which tokens attend to which
use_cases.context_pruning: Delete tokens with consistently low attention (dim tokens)

post_softmax_probabilities.characteristics: Interpretable probabilities showing relative attention strength
post_softmax_probabilities.usage: Suitable for brightness scoring with threshold-based comparisons
